ai_prompt: This bundle ships three log-density grids on a square [lo, hi]^2 grid (lo=-0.646, hi=0.818, n_grid=140) for the single observation y_obs = past_2period_imputed = [-0.10, +0.10, +0.10, +0.10, +0.10, +0.10] under the simulation-hockeystick DGP at HOCKEY_TRUTH (softplus-kink law of motion + sinh-arcsinh z_1 + sinh-arcsinh emission, theta=0). The three grids — `log_p_true`, `log_p_jn`, `log_p_mf` — are normalised so `max = 0`; convert to a density via P = exp(log_p) and pick contour levels in P-space (e.g. {0.01, 0.05, 0.1, 0.25, 0.5, 0.75, 0.9, 0.99}). Indexing convention: `log_p_*[i][j]` = log p(z_1 = z1_grid[i], z_2 = z2_grid[j] | y). The y_marker is (y_1, y_2); smc_marker is the SMC FFBS posterior mean of (z_1, z_2); diagonal_line is the z_1 = z_2 reference. The truth anchor (HOCKEY_TRUTH) is in `dgp`; the IVI cell JSON in `metadata.upstream_json` is the canonical source.
